verdicts.reason: Both candidates are essentially the same broken render. The quote 'Dogs never bite me — just humans', the Marilyn Monroe attribution and the dog photo are all missing. All that's left is a flat teal block in the middle and an empty outline frame floating to the right. The dog icons are piled up as a sprite sheet on the far right, a huge bone fragment sits top left, and a stray dotted rule floats beside them. Neither has any message, hierarchy or fidelity to the original, so both are unusable.
